name: bar-chart
title: BarChart
description: Selectable bar chart: one button per bar (height = value, colour = tone), dashed gridlines, a y axis on one or both sides, x labels, an optional overlay (a line), and a visually hidden table as its text equivalent. Used for the Tests conformance timeline (one bar per run) and the Usage invocations per hour.

a11y.pattern: role=group of <button aria-pressed> with a roving tabindex (one tab stop), plus a visually hidden <table> with a caption that holds every value
keyboard: Enters the chart on the selected bar (or the last one)
Selects and focuses the previous or next bar
Selects the first or last bar
aria: The group is named and says how to move ("Runs, oldest to newest. Use the arrow keys to move between bars.")
Each bar has a full aria-label ("Run #118, failed, 1.84 s, 6/7 samples passed"); the tone is never the only cue
Axes, gridlines, x labels and the overlay are aria-hidden: the hidden table is the text equivalent
Bars in the future are not buttons (nothing to select) and are hidden from assistive technology
Announce the selected bar's detail in a polite live region next to the chart
a11y.notes: The bars use --success, --danger, --warning, --running or --action fills, which keep 3:1 against the canvas in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). The selected bar adds an outline or a --link fill.
